description: This file contains the CSS styles for a simple web calculator, defining theme variables and styling for various components such as the calculator display, buttons, and container layout.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main styling for the application, setting minimum height, background, and text color.

classes.name: calc-container
classes.description: Styles for the calculator container including width, background, border radius, and box shadow.

classes.name: calc-display
classes.description: Styles for the calculator display component, including background, text color, font size, and alignment.

classes.name: calc-btn
classes.description: Base styles for calculator buttons, including background, color, size, and transition effects.

classes.name: calc-btn-equals
classes.description: Styles specifically for the equals button, defining background, text color, and focus effects.
